records.evidence_paraphrase: The issuer's FY2020 Item 5 identifies PAND common stock on Nasdaq and explicitly states that it has been publicly traded since July 17, 2020. The same section distinguishes the actual trading history from the registration and IPO closing dates. The stated historical interval covers the required September 30-December 30, 2020 lookback. The archived exchange addition table names PAND among operating biotechnology issuers effective December 21, 2020. Merck names Nasdaq PAND common stock when commencing its offer March 4. The conservative interval ends at the start of that documented listed day.
records.identity_source_locator: Target company named on filing cover, common-stock class, subject issuer CIK in immutable SEC accession path; announcement exhibit explicitly names historical Nasdaq ticker.
records.interval_method: Bounded retrospective identity interval beginning September 30, 2020, supported by explicit original-filing common-stock trading history. The fixed Nasdaq cohort entry remains December 21, 2020 and the previously reviewed interval end is retained. This is not an assertion that index selection occurred earlier or that the evidence was reviewed historically.
